name: Santa Fe Minerals Limited
summary: Santa Fe Minerals Limited operates as a gold and base metals exploration company in Australia. The company explores for gold, vanadium, copper, zinc, and other base metals. It holds seven exploration licenses in Challa South and Challa North projects covering an area of approximately 463 square kilometers in the Windamurra and Narndee Intrusions in Western Australia. The company was formerly known as EZA Corporation Limited and changed its name to Santa Fe Minerals Limited in October 2017. Santa Fe Minerals Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Nedlands, Australia.
